listenings.text: Good evening, and welcome to What to Watch. Here are my three recommendations for this week. The first one is a new series about a family in a small town. There is a lot of talking and no violence, so it is very good for people who like a quiet story. The second one is a French movie. I have to be honest: the beginning is slow, almost boring, but the end is beautiful, and I was very happy in the last ten minutes. And my last tip, for the people who write to me about learning English: watch an episode you know very well, an episode you can almost repeat, but with English subtitles. It works better than a new one. Have a very good week.

Hi, it's me. I'm calling about Saturday. I would like to have lunch with you and the family, and after that we can walk in the park near my house. I say lunch and not breakfast because I know you don't like waking up early on a Saturday, and I am the same. One more thing: there is a tennis club two streets from the park. It is open all day, so your daughter can play there in the afternoon while we finish the coffee. Call me back tonight and tell me what you think. Bye.

extra_audio.text: I like watching series in English. My favorite is The Big Bang Theory. I don't like waking up early. In Paris I would like to see a French movie. And you? What do you like doing?
